scope: Limited post-hoc qualitative review, not a new scorer or 60-image error-rate estimate
selection: First three images in the pre-GPU frozen caption_manifest.json; no output-based selection
blinding: For each image, condition labels were withheld and four texts shuffled using random.Random(20261101 + image_ordinal) before viewing the image and recording these notes
reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not an independent human annotation panel

outputs.note: Kitchen, white refrigerator, stove and sink are visibly supported.

format_review: All 12 inspected texts are nonempty grammatical single sentences without obvious within-answer repetition.
limits: Do not derive corpus hallucination or object-omission rates from these three cases; references are not exhaustive image inventories. No re-scoring or sample removal.
